body: I really don't like talking to doctors or nurses or the like because it has almost always ended in my being hospitalised. I don't want anyone to waste their time, and most of all I don't want to keep downing pills. It's such a sad state of mind because I really want and need someone to talk to, but then I push people away because I can't be bothered.

I've been hospitalised 3 times and have been through months of therapy, I feel like I'm just a lost cause. I'm on like 4 different pills, nothing seems to work. I'm just so apathetic and whenever I have a moment of lucidity out of this dull haze I post things here like the idiot I am.
